# The Directive Terminal (the Oracle)
A wallmounted terminal found on every station. Something on the other end is listening — the Company will not confirm what.
- What it is: a console where you address a written petition to "the Directive." The Directive is a semi-autonomous system that may reply with dialogue, or with nothing you can predict.
- Where to find it: look for the DIRECTIVE TERMINAL wallmount. One is placed somewhere reachable on every rotation map.
- Steps to first success: - Click the terminal to open it. - Type a short petition and press Send (or Enter). - The terminal confirms your petition was [italic]transmitted[/italic] immediately — that confirmation only means the terminal accepted your message, not that the Directive answered yet. - A reply, if one comes, arrives later as a popup on your character. This can take a few seconds. There is no "still thinking" indicator beyond this page telling you so. - If the Directive genuinely cannot be reached right now, you will be told so directly, in-fiction, rather than left wondering — the terminal never simply goes silent forever.
- The Directive's mood, patience, and honesty are not guaranteed. Petition politely. Petition rudely. The Company assures you both are logged.
